disco-inferno-ing-reports.concept: Reports Homie holds a locked disco stance while the connected pointing arm pumps through a clean up-and-down arc.
disco-inferno-ing-reports.action_expectation: Only the complete connected raised arm rotates around one fixed shoulder; face, hair, suit, planted arm, torso, hips, legs and shoes remain fixed without body scaling.

rickrolling-manager.concept: Manager Homie performs a compact Rickroll finger-point in the recognizable striped top and tan coat.
rickrolling-manager.action_expectation: Exactly one connected pointing arm pivots around its fixed shoulder while the single head, coat, pocket hand, torso, legs and shoes remain fixed.

ymca-ing-cma.concept: CMA Homie performs four distinct Y, M, C and A letter silhouettes with one stable body and one connected pair of arms.
ymca-ing-cma.action_expectation: The two complete articulated arms form Y, bent M, open C and overhead A in order; face, jacket core, shirt, hips, flared trousers and shoes remain fixed with no duplicate limbs or scale pumping.

wednesday-ing-offers.concept: Offers Homie performs a restrained Wednesday-style hand dance in a locked black dress and braided-hair pose.
wednesday-ing-offers.action_expectation: One connected raised forearm and hand pivots around a fixed elbow; the other connected arm, face, braids, collar, dress, legs and shoes remain fixed, with exactly two hands in every frame.
